content.short: Ionic Protocol is the primary lending platform on the Mode network, offering optimized interest rates for LSTs.
content.description:
Ionic Protocol is the definitive money market and lending platform built natively for the Mode Network, an Ethereum Layer 2 powered by the OP Stack. Designed for maximum capital efficiency, the protocol supports a wide range of assets, including Liquid Staking Tokens (LSTs) and Liquid Restaking Tokens (LRTs), allowing users to earn optimized yields while maintaining liquidity. A portion of the protocol's fees is shared with $ION stakers, fostering a community-driven and sustainable financial ecosystem.

Deeply integrated with Mode's incentive structures and the broader Optimism Superchain, Ionic Protocol provides users with institutional-grade financial tools in a non-custodial environment. The platform focuses on professional-grade risk management and transparent operations, aiming to become the central liquidity hub for the Mode ecosystem. Through its commitment to innovation and user-centric design, Ionic Protocol is empowering participants to build and manage sophisticated financial portfolios on-chain.
